batches.notes: First content batch, revised with explicit repeatability/fallback policy. JSON is canonical; Markdown is generated deterministically and MUST NOT be hand-edited. Revised to follow soft-evidence drafting: ordinary material commitment events use NORMAL local weight rather than HIGH.

text.en: Your birth certificate includes a blank for expected post-mobility material. Your parents leave it empty; the clerk circles it in red.

events.designerNotes: Early worldbuilding. SPR +1 represents a comparatively stable early household response, not infant psychology literally.

text.en: Your family learns to stretch every household budget. You learn that 'temporary' furniture can last nine years.
Your family replaces the living-room furniture. The old sofa is sold to a preservation clinic as 'lightly used support equipment.'

events.designerNotes: MNY in childhood means household resources.

text.en: You start school. Your first timetable includes mathematics, language, and Basic Post-Mobility Etiquette.

events.designerNotes: Establishes education as normalized institutional exposure.

text.en: Solidification Safety Week ends with a smiling traffic-cone mascot and a mandatory quiz. You fail the section titled 'Remain Calm.'
Solidification Safety Week ends with a smiling traffic-cone mascot and a mandatory quiz. Everyone receives a certificate for remaining mobile.

events.designerNotes: Black-humor school event; no harmful transformation.

text.en: A school material-resonance screening reports an unusual affinity for wood. Your parents receive a brochure titled 'Probably Nothing.'
A school material-resonance screening reports unusually strong stone affinity. The counselor calls this 'career-relevant.'
A school material-resonance screening finds a bright crystalline response. The form has no checkbox for wings interfering with the scanner.
A school material-resonance screening produces a dark glass-like reading. The machine prints 'RETEST' three times and gives up.
A school material-resonance screening detects a strong metallic response. The finance club asks whether the result is taxable.
A school material-resonance screening finds nothing remarkable. Your parents are told that this is not a guarantee.

events.designerNotes: Species-flavored hints only; no Material Commitment.

text.en: You score unusually well on a standardized aptitude test. Several adults immediately make this your responsibility.
You complete a standardized aptitude test. The report confidently predicts a profession that will not exist by the time you graduate.

events.designerNotes: Stat growth plus gifted-child pressure.

text.en: Your career counselor recommends construction before asking what you enjoy. You had written 'marine biology.'
Your career counselor recommends ceremonial public service because you have wings. You ask whether accounting is still available.
Your career counselor asks whether you have considered contract law. You have not yet said anything about contracts.
Your career counselor suggests finance because of your 'natural relationship with value.' The phrase remains in your school record.
Your career counselor suggests conservation, forestry, or 'something tasteful.' You ask what that means and receive no useful answer.
Your career counselor uses an algorithm to recommend your future. It recommends 'flexibility.'

events.designerNotes: Species stereotypes as Human-centered institutional comedy.

text.en: Two fingers turn wooden during an exam and return to normal before lunch. The school nurse finds the old screening result and writes 'consistent.'
Two fingers turn wooden during an exam and return to normal before lunch. The school nurse gives you a late-pass and a leaflet.

events.designerNotes: Minor reversible under-18 manifestation. Never commits material.

text.en: Your school offers subsidized student transformation insurance. The affordable plan excludes 'aesthetic continuity.'
Your school offers student transformation insurance. The introductory rate expires the day you turn eighteen.

events.designerNotes: Sets up adulthood as an insurance threshold.

text.en: You graduate with excellent marks. Several institutions congratulate you by sending forms.
You graduate. Your school returns your mobility deposit after deducting an administrative fee.

events.designerNotes: Can occur at 17 or 18/19; still nonterminal.

text.en: You land your first serious office job. Management calls you 'high potential' before learning where the supply closet is.
You land your first serious office job. The employee handbook has fourteen pages on Permanent Form and two on vacation.

events.designerNotes: Soft Corporate route entry.

text.en: Your employer adds permanent-preservation coverage to the benefits package. HR calls it a retention initiative.

events.designerNotes: Schedules later contract review while allowing intervening ordinary life.

text.en: Fine wood grain appears along your forearms. A doctor asks whether anyone ever followed up on your childhood screening.
Fine wood grain appears along your forearms and fades only partially. The clinic describes this as 'persistent but presently decorative.'

events.designerNotes: Adult manifestation; still no commitment.

text.en: Thin crystalline lines appear beneath your skin. Your old school screening is suddenly considered medically relevant.
Thin crystalline lines appear beneath your skin. The clinic asks you not to stand near direct showroom lighting.

events.designerNotes: Crystal manifestation counterpart; future batch should add crystal commitment.

text.en: An adult Fixation screening returns a result the physician rereads twice. She schedules the discussion before explaining the number.
An adult Fixation screening comes back elevated. The physician calls it manageable, then gives you three specialist referrals.
An adult Fixation screening finds nothing urgent. The clinic recommends repeating it forever.

events.designerNotes: Player never sees exact FIX; text communicates band.

text.en: A curator tells you that you have 'exceptional preservation potential.' This is apparently a compliment.
A museum curator asks whether you have ever considered long-term preservation. You had been asking for directions.
A museum survey asks how you would feel about being displayed after Permanent Form. The final option is 'No strong preference.'

events.designerNotes: Soft Museum route seed. No player response choice.

text.en: A lender adds a projected Permanent Form valuation to your application. The number is higher than your current net worth.
A lender adds your projected Permanent Form to the collateral model. Your interest rate improves.
A lender offers a future-form valuation as part of your application. You decline to ask how they estimated it.

events.designerNotes: Establishes body valuation without immediately creating debt route climax.

text.en: Your employer sends a preservation contract. You notice the ownership clause before HR finishes saying 'standard language.'
Your employer sends a preservation contract. The signature page is much shorter than the section on display rights.

events.designerNotes: Automatic variant; contract review changes later ending outcome potential.

text.en: The grain in your arms deepens into permanent hardwood. A hairline split appears at the wrist before the doctor finishes saying 'stable.'
The grain in your arms deepens into permanent hardwood. The specialist changes your file from 'manifestation' to 'structural conversion.'

events.designerNotes: First explicit material-commitment event in the content set.

text.en: Your condition finally activates the preservation contract. The company completes the conversion, but the revised paperwork leaves the Permanent Form legally yours.
Your condition finally activates the preservation benefit. The low-cost procedure works exactly as advertised, which turns out to be a carefully chosen sentence.
Your condition finally activates the preservation contract. By Monday, your new position is in the lobby.

events.designerNotes: First full route climax. Material is inherited from MAT; no material replacement.

text.en: A relative remarks on how much you have grown. The family record updates your height and leaves Material Status blank.

events.designerNotes: Repeatable early-childhood baseline. Safe character development; no fixation or material commitment.

text.en: Another school year ends with excellent marks. The school recommends an enrichment program and three additional forms.
Another school year passes. You learn several useful things and one officially approved definition of 'permanent.'

events.designerNotes: Repeatable primary-school baseline.

text.en: You make a friend at school. You agree that neither of you wants to become part of the assembly hall.

events.designerNotes: Repeatable social baseline with ordinary character development.

text.en: Exam season arrives again. Your school reminds students that stress-related mineral symptoms do not excuse late submissions.
Exam season arrives again. You study hard enough to recognize several questions from last year's officially different exam.

events.designerNotes: Repeatable adolescent baseline; no actual damaging transformation.

text.en: You spend more time with classmates after school. Someone starts a rumor about everyone's future Permanent Form; yours is inaccurate but flattering.

events.designerNotes: Repeatable adolescent social baseline.

text.en: You take temporary work to cover expenses. The contract is short enough that its post-mobility clause is almost funny.
You spend another year learning how work actually functions. This knowledge is not included in the employee handbook.

events.designerNotes: Repeatable early-adult baseline. Ensures 18-24 has ordinary content even without route entry.

text.en: You move somewhere cheaper. The lease prohibits structural incorporation without written permission from the landlord.
You move to a slightly better place. The building manager points out the freight elevator 'for future accessibility.'

events.designerNotes: Repeatable early-adult housing baseline.

text.en: Nothing particularly unusual happens this year. Several institutions remind you that this does not constitute a guarantee.

events.designerNotes: Last-resort fallback only. Forbidden before age 25 and never participates in normal weighted drafting.

batches.notes: Second content batch. Adds Stone/Metal/Glass/Crystal commitment, Museum and Medical climaxes, Temporal fixation, Architectural route, mid-life preservation culture, and 45+ mobile-survivor content. Revised to follow soft-evidence drafting: ordinary material commitment events use NORMAL local weight rather than HIGH.

text.en: A patch of skin at your shoulder hardens into smooth stone and slowly softens again. The clinic marks your old school screening as 'retrospectively useful.'
A patch of skin at your shoulder hardens into smooth stone and slowly softens again. The clinic calls it a reversible structural episode.

events.designerNotes: Stone manifestation. Does not commit material.

text.en: The stone at your shoulder stops softening and spreads across your upper arm. The specialist calls the density 'excellent,' then remembers this is a medical appointment.
The stone at your shoulder stops softening and spreads across your upper arm. Your file is updated from 'episode' to 'conversion.'

events.designerNotes: Stone Material Commitment.

text.en: Metal objects begin clinging weakly to your forearms. A doctor asks you to stop demonstrating this with clinic stationery.
A metallic sheen appears beneath your skin whenever you are tired. The clinic adds 'avoid strong magnets' to your otherwise normal discharge notes.

events.designerNotes: Metal manifestation; Magnetic Personality gets a literal interaction.

text.en: The metallic sheen becomes permanent and dense. A valuation service contacts you before the specialist does.
The metallic layer beneath your skin becomes permanent. Your physician assures you the alloy is medically ordinary.

events.designerNotes: Metal Material Commitment; Dragonkin can attract financial attention.

text.en: A dark glassy patch forms around one wrist and reflects light like polished obsidian. The clinic's scanner labels it 'decorative interference.'
A translucent glassy patch forms around one wrist and fades only slightly. The clinic gives you protective sleeves and a brochure on glare.

events.designerNotes: Glass/obsidian manifestation.

text.en: The dark glass at your wrist stops fading and spreads in a clean obsidian surface. The specialist describes the finish as 'unusually successful' and apologizes.
The glassy patch at your wrist becomes permanent and begins spreading. Your chart now includes a section titled 'breakage planning.'

events.designerNotes: Glass Material Commitment.

text.en: The crystalline lines stop receding and lock into a permanent lattice. The specialist asks whether you have a museum contact before discussing treatment.
The crystalline lines stop receding and lock into a permanent lattice. The clinic upgrades your condition from 'cosmetic' to 'structural.'

events.designerNotes: Crystal commitment completes the manifestation begun in Batch 001.

text.en: A conservator examines the grain developing across your body and discusses humidity control with unusual enthusiasm.
A curator dims the room before examining your crystalline structure. The museum's research department requests a copy of your medical file.
A museum appraiser evaluates your developing Permanent Form. The appointment ends with more measurements than explanations.

events.designerNotes: Museum appraisal schedules a later climax while adapting to committed material.

text.en: Your final crystallization is transferred into the museum's research archive. The catalogue describes you as both a person and a storage medium.
The museum completes your preservation under a custody agreement that leaves ownership legally yours. The gift shop remains disappointed.
The museum completes your preservation and places you on permanent display. The condition report praises the finish before mentioning your name.
The museum completes your preservation and transfers you to long-term conservation. Your file is marked 'excellent condition, routine maintenance.'

events.designerNotes: Museum climax with crystal-academic, legal, display, and conservation variants.

text.en: A continuity researcher recruits you after you describe a place you have never visited with uncomfortable accuracy.
A research institute recruits you for a study on Permanent Form continuity. The consent form is longer than the published paper.

events.designerNotes: Academic route seed; useful for Crystal Archivist and future hidden routes.

text.en: A preservation specialist calls your condition 'an opportunity to choose the timing.' The brochure calls this proactive aging.
A preservation specialist recommends planning for Permanent Form before the decision becomes medically urgent. The brochure uses the phrase 'future-proofing.'

events.designerNotes: Medical preservation consultation can lead to a deliberate mid-life ending.

text.en: You undergo the lowest-cost permanent preservation the clinic can legally advertise. The synthetic result is durable, standardized, and very definitely yours according to page fourteen.
You decide that waiting for a worse condition would be inefficient. The clinic preserves you in a custom synthetic form while the promotional discount still applies.
The clinic completes permanent preservation using your existing material condition and the cheapest compatible maintenance plan. Both technically work.
You schedule permanent preservation before further aging complicates the procedure. The clinic calls the result your final version.

events.designerNotes: Deliberate preservation climax. Can create Synthetic commitment only when no prior material exists.

text.en: Several friends begin discussing whether they should preserve themselves 'before anything starts to sag.' You are asked for recommendations.
Someone in your social circle announces a mid-life preservation consultation. Everyone reacts as though she bought an expensive car.

events.designerNotes: Mid-life crisis humor without forcing the protagonist into a route.

text.en: Your company offers an Executive Final Form package. The presentation spends twenty minutes on legacy and thirty seconds on immobility.
Your company launches an Executive Final Form package. You are not senior enough for the premium materials, but HR adds you to the mailing list.

events.designerNotes: Corporate mid-life preservation marketing.

text.en: For eleven seconds, everything except you appears to stop moving. The emergency department classifies this as successful spontaneous stabilization.
For eleven seconds, your reflection stops moving before you do. The clinic files the incident under temporal fixation and asks whether it happens often.

events.designerNotes: Temporal manifestation; no commitment yet.

text.en: The Continuity Research Institute invites you into a temporal study. The equipment is cutting-edge; the consent form still uses last year's logo.
The Continuity Research Institute invites you into a temporal study. You are classified as a participant, not an equipment fault.

events.designerNotes: Schedules temporal climax.

text.en: The Institute's stabilization field locks you outside ordinary time. Your advance directive survives the procedure better than the laboratory clock.
The Institute's stabilization field locks you outside ordinary time. The experiment is declared complete after everyone else has waited several hours.

events.designerNotes: Temporal commitment and ending occur together; default awareness is Suspended.

text.en: You become one of the longest-mobile employees in your department. HR sends a congratulatory card and a preservation brochure in the same envelope.
Another working year passes without permanent conversion. A younger colleague asks whether this is intentional.

events.designerNotes: Repeatable later-career survivor content.

text.en: A routine checkup confirms that you remain mobile despite increasingly unconvincing statistics. The doctor changes the subject to maintenance planning.
A routine checkup finds nothing immediately alarming. The doctor congratulates you on continued mobility as though you personally arranged it.

events.designerNotes: Aging can affect STR without turning old age into the main ending mechanism.

text.en: Your insurer offers a longevity discount for remaining mobile past its original model. The discount is smaller than the fee for recalculating the model.
Your insurer requests confirmation that you are still capable of movement. The form includes a checkbox labeled 'surprisingly, yes.'

events.designerNotes: Late mobility treated as an actuarial anomaly.

text.en: A government survey classifies you as an Older Mobile Citizen. The category was introduced recently enough that the website still redirects incorrectly.
A government survey asks why you remain mobile past the national median conversion age. 'No particular reason' is not one of the listed answers.

events.designerNotes: Survivor worldbuilding; does not imply exact public statistics.

text.en: You attend another reunion and are once again the only person who arrives under her own power. Someone saves you the chair with the best view of everyone else.
You attend another reunion and are once again the only person who arrives under her own power. Nobody knows whether this is admirable or inconvenient.

events.designerNotes: Repeatable 60+ social baseline so late survivors still have life content.

text.en: You reorganize part of your life for reasons that feel important at the time. No institution manages to monetize this immediately.

events.designerNotes: Ordinary mid-life baseline distinct from the fallback and from preservation culture.

text.en: A specialist notes that your committed material has remained unusually stable while you are still mobile. The report calls this 'functionally inconvenient but clinically impressive.'
A specialist notes that your committed material is progressing slowly enough to preserve mobility for now. Your next appointment is scheduled optimistically.

events.designerNotes: Allows some committed-material protagonists to remain mobile into later ages.

text.en: A structural contractor offers you consulting work after seeing your material condition. The accessibility meeting is held at a table designed for Humans.
A structural contractor asks whether your developing material could qualify for a long-term installation program. The brochure calls it vocational continuity.

events.designerNotes: Architectural route seed for Stone/Metal commitments.

text.en: Your conversion is incorporated into the new structure under a contract preserving legal ownership of the Permanent Form. The building owner calls this administratively inconvenient.
Your conversion is completed as part of the new structure. The final inspection lists you between load-bearing supports and fire exits.

events.designerNotes: Architectural climax; legal talent can produce a fixture/personhood contradiction.

batches.notes: Third content batch. Broadens ordinary life and institutions: species accommodations, Family, Legal, Finance, Religious, Civic, friendship, and associated endings. Avoids adding new material families.

text.en: Your school installs new wing-compatible chairs. The backs are wider, the desks are narrower, and nobody with wings was consulted.

events.designerNotes: Winged Kin accommodation satire; Human-centered design rather than biological destiny.

text.en: The school updates its uniform policy to permit horns. The helmet requirement remains unchanged.

events.designerNotes: Demonkin accommodation joke.

text.en: A government biometric terminal is mounted above comfortable reach. A folding stool labeled 'reasonable accommodation' is chained to the wall.

events.designerNotes: Dwarf Human-scale infrastructure satire.

text.en: A public building's thermal scanner flags your normal body temperature as a safety event. Security apologizes after locating the Dragonkin checkbox.

events.designerNotes: Dragonkin thermal accommodation.

text.en: Someone compliments your 'timeless Elven look' and immediately asks whether you plan to preserve it. You had been discussing coffee.

events.designerNotes: Elf preservation stereotype without material lock.

text.en: A government form lists Human as the default species and asks everyone else to specify. You briefly experience the privilege of not noticing a design choice.

events.designerNotes: Human-centered society expressed without mechanical bonus.

text.en: Your family casually discusses where you would fit after Permanent Form. The conversation becomes unexpectedly specific about floor load.
Your family casually discusses future Permanent Form arrangements over dinner. Nobody remembers who started the conversation.

events.designerNotes: Family placement route seed.

text.en: You formalize post-mobility placement instructions before anyone can call them 'family understandings.' The lawyer adds several pages about ownership.
Your family writes down a post-mobility placement plan. Nobody is certain whether the document is legally meaningful, but everyone signs it anyway.

events.designerNotes: Family/legal bridge.

text.en: Your Permanent Form is placed with your family under the directive you prepared years ago. The certificate lists you as self-owned and the house as your approved location.
Your Permanent Form is placed in the family garden as planned. Someone immediately argues about whether seasonal decorations violate the arrangement.
Your Permanent Form returns to the family home. Future generations inherit both you and the unresolved question of where you belong.

events.designerNotes: Family climax with self-ownership or garden/heirloom outcomes.

text.en: A routine Material Status filing becomes a legal consultation when you notice that the form treats 'person' and 'object' as mutually exclusive.
A routine Material Status filing asks whether your committed material is 'primarily personal' or 'primarily property.' You request clarification and receive another form.

events.designerNotes: General legal-status route seed.

text.en: The status hearing recognizes your advance directives as continuing exercises of personhood. The ruling is immediately appealed by someone with a financial interest.
The status hearing grants you limited post-mobility protections while declining to define what category you belong to. Everyone claims this is progress.
The status hearing concludes that existing law is adequate. Nobody present can explain what that means for you.

events.designerNotes: Nonterminal legal resolution can influence future ending variants.

text.en: Money becomes tight again. Your budgeting system becomes so efficient that friends begin asking for the spreadsheet.
Money becomes tight again. You learn exactly which bills consider 'future mobility' a relevant risk category.

events.designerNotes: Repeatable financial stress without immediate route commitment.

text.en: A lender offers to refinance your debts against the future value of your Permanent Form. The monthly payment improves immediately.
A lender offers a secured loan based on a future-form valuation you have not yet received. Their confidence is not reassuring.

events.designerNotes: Finance route seed; debt tied to future form.

text.en: Your Permanent Form is completed just as the secured debt becomes due. The creditor accepts repayment instead of possession and sounds disappointed.
The debt is cleared through a low-cost preservation settlement. Your account balance reaches zero at the same moment your ownership status changes.
Your Permanent Form is completed and the lender exercises its secured claim. The final valuation matches the loan documents almost exactly.

events.designerNotes: Finance climax: value retained, settlement, or creditor realization.

text.en: A religious organization invites you to a ceremony because your wings are 'symbolically appropriate.' The invitation insists this is not species profiling.
A religious organization invites you to a panel on appearances and moral panic. The promotional poster uses your silhouette without asking.
A religious community invites you to help with a permanence ceremony. Their theology is more nuanced than their insurance paperwork.
A local religious group distributes a leaflet explaining the spiritual meaning of Permanent Form. The footnotes disagree with the headline.

events.designerNotes: Religious route seed with species/social interpretation.

text.en: The religious community interprets your committed material as spiritually significant. A lawyer quietly asks whether 'significant' includes ownership.
The religious community declares your committed material ceremonially important. Civil authorities request a clearer noun.

events.designerNotes: Sets up sacred-property/legal contradiction.

text.en: Your Permanent Form is installed for ceremonial use while the civil court refuses to concede ownership. The religious registry and legal registry list different answers.
Your Permanent Form is installed as a sacred object. Civil authorities open an appeal before the dedication ceremony has finished.

events.designerNotes: Religious climax.

text.en: You become unexpectedly visible in a local civic campaign. Someone describes you as 'the face of the initiative' before checking whether you wanted that job.
You volunteer for a local civic program. Most of the work consists of helping residents navigate other civic programs.

events.designerNotes: Civic route entry.

text.en: Officials propose recognizing your public service through the Civic Legacy Program. The presentation renders you in bronze regardless of your actual material condition.
Officials add you to a Civic Legacy shortlist. The application asks whether your future monument should remain politically neutral.

events.designerNotes: Civic memorial route stage.

text.en: The civic campaign that promoted you becomes politically inconvenient. Officials assure you that the Legacy Program itself is strictly nonpartisan.
The civic campaign that promoted you quietly changes its name, colors, and stated purpose. Your Legacy paperwork remains valid.

events.designerNotes: Allows Politically Neutral Landmark ending before climax.

text.en: Your Permanent Form is unveiled after officials remove every reference to the campaign that made you famous. The new plaque identifies you simply as 'a civic figure.'
Your Permanent Form is unveiled in a public square as an official memorial. The ceremony repeatedly refers to your continued civic presence.

events.designerNotes: Civic climax.

text.en: You meet friends for dinner. Someone asks about your committed material, someone else changes the subject, and the evening improves immediately.
You meet friends for dinner and spend most of the evening discussing matters that will never appear on a Material Status form.

events.designerNotes: Ordinary adult friendship keeps non-institutional life present.

text.en: A family gathering lasts longer than planned. Nobody discusses preservation until dessert, which counts as progress.
A family gathering lasts longer than planned. Three relatives offer incompatible advice about your future Permanent Form.

events.designerNotes: Repeatable midlife family baseline.

text.en: You discover that your secured loan treats display rights, sale rights, and relocation rights as three separate assets. You renegotiate two of them.
Your secured lender sends an updated notice explaining which rights attach to your future Permanent Form. The diagram makes matters worse.

events.designerNotes: Legal/finance intersection; future ending variants can use ROUTE_FIN_LEGAL_REVIEW.

batches.notes: Fourth content batch. Completes the ~100-event first slice with additional ordinary-life density, Ceramic and Synthetic progression, Academic endings, explicit Mixed Media transition, post-commitment medical directives, and late-mobile survivor content. Academic route revised so tenure follows an interdisciplinary research specialization rather than acting as the route's entire identity.

text.en: Before you are old enough to notice, your family keeps a hand-me-down stroller in service. Its warranty excludes future structural conversion, which nobody remembers purchasing.
Your family discovers how quickly baby supplies become the wrong size. The receipts are kept longer than the useful sizing labels.

events.designerNotes: Additional early-childhood family density.

text.en: You are cast as a statue in the school play because you can stand still convincingly. The costume department considers this excellent foreshadowing.
You join an after-school club and discover that adults will supervise almost any activity if it produces a certificate.

events.designerNotes: Ordinary school development with mild setting humor.

text.en: You take an advanced elective. The teacher warns that university credit is transferable but post-mobility credit is jurisdiction-dependent.
You take an elective mostly because your friends are there. It becomes unexpectedly useful several years later.

events.designerNotes: Repeatable adolescent education density.

text.en: You attempt to get into better shape. Progress is slow, measurable, and not accepted by your insurer as a material-risk intervention.
You become temporarily serious about exercise. Your body responds better than your schedule does.

events.designerNotes: Ordinary adult health event unrelated to fixation.

text.en: Dating becomes easier than deciding what to write under 'long-term mobility expectations.' You leave the field blank.
You go on a few dates. One person asks about your future Permanent Form before asking what music you like.

events.designerNotes: Young-adult social life; no route commitment.

text.en: You change jobs for better pay. The new employer promises a 'modern approach to mobility continuity,' which means a newer PDF.
Your work becomes more complicated without becoming more important. You are compensated for one of these changes.

events.designerNotes: Career progression independent of the dedicated Corporate route.

text.en: You move homes and discover that the lease now asks for your projected floor-loading requirements. The agent calls this standard accessibility planning.
You move homes. Half your possessions fit perfectly in boxes designed for something else.

events.designerNotes: Ordinary housing remains relevant after material commitment.

text.en: An old friend asks how your material condition is progressing, then spends the rest of the evening talking about her divorce. You appreciate the change of subject.
You reconnect with an old friend. Both of you have acquired enough paperwork to compare notes.

events.designerNotes: Midlife friendship density.

text.en: You consider retirement. The pension portal assumes you entered Permanent Form years ago and asks you to correct your status by mail.
Retirement planning begins to sound less hypothetical. Your advisor has to reopen a spreadsheet tab labeled 'still mobile.'

events.designerNotes: Late-career survivor event.

text.en: Another year passes while you remain mobile. This is no longer remarkable to you, which makes it increasingly remarkable to everyone else.

events.designerNotes: Real late-life baseline distinct from fallback-only quiet year.

text.en: A smooth porcelain-like patch appears along your collarbone and resists every moisturizer you own. The clinic compliments the finish before examining it.
A pale ceramic patch appears along your collarbone and gives a faint tap when touched. The clinic advises against testing this repeatedly.

events.designerNotes: Ceramic/porcelain manifestation; remains soft evidence.

text.en: The ceramic surface stops receding and spreads with an unusually clean porcelain finish. A curator requests photographs before your physician finishes the diagnosis.
The ceramic surface stops receding and becomes structurally permanent. Your chart adds a warning about impact resistance.

events.designerNotes: Ceramic Material Commitment; NORMAL weight follows soft-evidence rule.

text.en: A specialist suggests a synthetic stabilization scaffold before your symptoms become structural. The premium model has a better warranty than your phone.
A specialist offers synthetic stabilization as one possible way to contain your Fixation. The brochure has separate pages for economy, archival, and bespoke finishes.

events.designerNotes: Synthetic is a medical route option, not synonymous with cheapness.

text.en: You undergo bespoke synthetic stabilization. The resulting material is custom-matched, medically durable, and expensive enough to have its own financing department.
You undergo synthetic stabilization. The material integrates cleanly and is described as 'standard grade,' which the clinic insists is not the same as cheap.

events.designerNotes: Nonterminal Synthetic Material Commitment.

text.en: After years of publishing across material-conversion fields, your institute places you on tenure track. Your teaching load now includes a course called Comparative Permanence.
Your work on continuity and suspended awareness earns you a tenure-track position. The university asks you not to describe the field as 'philosophy with laboratory accidents.'
Your post-mobile governance research earns you a tenure-track position shared between departments that disagree about which one employs you.
Your institute offers a long-term research appointment. The contract uses the phrase 'subject to continued mobility' in two different senses.

events.designerNotes: Tenure is a career consequence after substantive research specialization, not the Academic route's defining feature.

text.en: Your tenure review succeeds. The university officially describes your position as permanent and everyone avoids commenting on the wording.
Your tenure review produces a conditional extension and six pages of feedback. One page concerns your future material status.

events.designerNotes: Automatic academic branch schedules one of two climax families.

text.en: Your final conversion is completed on university grounds beside laboratories studying half a dozen other possible outcomes. The faculty directory lists your field as Comparative Permanence and your office as the courtyard.

Your final conversion is completed on university grounds after a career spent asking what survives transformation. Your title remains Professor; the answer to your research question remains more carefully worded.
Your final conversion is completed on university grounds after years of writing about post-mobile status. The university immediately consults your own publications to decide how to classify you.
Your final conversion is completed on university grounds. The faculty directory changes your office number to the courtyard and leaves your title unchanged.

events.designerNotes: Tenure ending adapts to the research history that produced it.

text.en: Your final conversion occurs during a comparative-material project. The paper gains an unexpected first-person dataset and a much longer ethics appendix.
Your final conversion occurs during the continuity study that has occupied most of your career. The paper's discussion section becomes considerably less hypothetical.
Your final conversion occurs while your team is studying post-mobile classification. The case study is published before the agencies involved finish deciding which dataset you belong in.
Your final conversion occurs during the project that has occupied most of your career. The paper is revised to include the principal investigator as a result.

events.designerNotes: Peer-Reviewed Permanence adapts to materials, continuity, or policy research.

text.en: Conservators propose reinforcing your developing fractures with a second material. The treatment plan uses the phrase 'visible repair as biography.'
Conservators propose a second-material reinforcement to improve long-term stability. The treatment is introduced as both medical care and mixed-media conservation.

events.designerNotes: Explicit path toward mixed material; never happens accidentally.

text.en: The reinforcement procedure permanently integrates a second material into your body. Your file now requires both a physician and a conservator to sign the same page.

events.designerNotes: Explicit authored transition to MIXD. Implementation should preserve prior material(s) in ending metadata before overwriting MAT.

text.en: Your final preservation is catalogued as mixed media. The museum lists your component materials in a more prominent font than your biography.

events.designerNotes: Mixed Media ending.

text.en: A clinic asks you to file maintenance directives for your committed material. Your lawyer turns the one-page form into a small constitutional document.
A clinic asks you to file maintenance preferences for your committed material. 'Do not polish without consent' is already a standard checkbox.

events.designerNotes: Ordinary institutional response after material commitment; reinforces autonomy themes without ending.

Your building completes an accessibility retrofit. The notice congratulates Human residents for experiencing no disruption.

Everlasting updates your policy illustration using the same projection from your original application, now labeled “historical baseline.”
Black Ledger sends a servicing notice on the same account it once called an emergency solution. You clear enough of the balance to terminate the relationship.
Black Ledger offers a payment holiday if you sign an updated collateral schedule. Your finances improve dramatically and your projected future body receives its first itemized value.
Black Ledger restructures the account again. The new payment is easier; the definition of collateral is not.
The woman who first invited you to the Order asks whether you still intend to attend. You give a clear no, and the Order records the withdrawal as a completed posture.
The Order gives you a room, meals, and several weeks in which nobody asks you to explain why you are tired. By the time you feel better, the ritual schedule has become part of the arrangement.
